verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a batch inference mode that processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% off serverless per-token prices, which is a real bulk operation for an inference platform. The evidence is a single repeated one-line claim, though, and covers only bulk inference requests, not bulk actions on other resources. Missing for 10: details of the batch workflow (input format, job submission, limits, status and results retrieval), bulk management of resources like models and deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
